title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Enhancing Financial Decision-Making and Administrative Efficiency: A Systematic Review
authors: Al-E'mari, S.; Sanjalawe, Y.; Al-E'mari, A.
tldr: A systematic review of 2014-2024 literature examines how AI, including predictive analytics, machine learning, and robotic process automation, enhances financial decision-making and administrative efficiency while identifying key privacy, ethical, and implementation challenges.
problem_and_motivation: There is a significant gap in understanding the comprehensive benefits and challenges of integrating AI across both financial and administrative domains.
approach: Systematic literature search across five academic databases (IEEE Xplore, PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, ScienceDirect) using Boolean keyword combinations.
Inclusion criteria limited to peer-reviewed English studies from 2014 to 2024 on AI applications in finance and administration.
Three-stage study selection process with two independent reviewers: title screening, abstract review, and full-text assessment.
Data extraction focusing on AI application type, process impact, methodology, and key findings from selected studies.
Structured evaluation framework employing qualitative and quantitative methods using KPIs such as time savings, cost reductions, error rates, and decision accuracy.
Case study analysis examining real-world AI implementations across large enterprises and SMEs in finance, healthcare, retail, and administrative sectors.
Synthesis of current trends, challenges, ethical considerations, and emerging opportunities in AI adoption for finance and administration.
findings: num: 99% reduction in manual legal review time achieved by JPMorgan Chase's COiN platform, saving approximately $100 million annually.
num: 35% improvement in fraud detection rates by Ant Financial's AI system compared to traditional rule-based systems.
num: 20% improvement in forecasting accuracy and 30% reduction in market reaction time by BlackRock's Aladdin system.
num: 20-60% average efficiency improvements from RPA applications in administrative tasks across healthcare and finance.
num: 80% reduction in billing processing times and 60% increase in operational efficiency from UiPath RPA in healthcare.
num: 70% reduction in reporting times and manual data management efforts at Siemens through AI-driven automation.
num: 200% ROI reported by a major financial services company from AI-driven predictive analytics in risk management.
Broad AI use across multiple functions shows strongest correlations with performance metrics: 0.61 for speed and 0.48 for decision-making.
key_figures_tables: Figure 1: Efficiency gains from AI in data reporting → Showcases improvements in time saved, reporting accuracy, and error reduction.
Figure 2: Performance impact of AI on decision-making → Broad AI use shows highest correlation with speed (0.61) and decision-making (0.48).
Figure 3: Comparison of AI case studies → Provides quantitative comparison of time saved and accuracy improvements across implementations.

definitions.definition: Artificial Intelligence, computational systems mimicking human cognitive functions for learning and decision-making.
Robotic Process Automation, AI-driven software bots replicating human actions for routine repetitive tasks.
Personally Identifiable Information, data that can identify a specific individual including financial records.
General Data Protection Regulation, EU regulation governing personal data collection, storage, and usage rights.
Natural Language Processing, AI technology enabling computers to understand and process human language.
Optical Character Recognition, technology that converts document images into editable structured data.
Anti-Money Laundering, regulations and processes for detecting and preventing illegal financial activity.
Know Your Customer, protocols for verifying customer identity to ensure regulatory compliance.
Key Performance Indicators, measurable benchmarks for evaluating process efficiency and outcomes.
Explainable AI, techniques that make AI decision-making processes transparent and interpretable.
California Consumer Privacy Act, US regulation protecting consumer data privacy and transparency rights.
Return on Investment, metric measuring the financial gain relative to the cost of an investment.
Small and Medium-sized Enterprise, a business whose personnel and revenue fall below certain thresholds.
